01 Business model

How our
model works.

Localization for one language market is often the first step: a rights holder licenses us that market, sees the results, and opens the title to YouTube in more markets and territories.

01LicenseTypically exclusive in the core territory of the language market (e.g. MENA for Arabic), non-exclusive worldwide.
02Fund localizationAt our cost — the rights holder pays nothing.
03Release & protectProgrammed and monetized on our channels; rights protected in-house.
04Analyze demandWatch-time data drives the next acquisitions.
Who benefits from the model
YouTubeLicensed content new to the platform — localized by us for new language markets, and in its original language.
Rights holdersNew markets, revenue and data on where their content is in demand.
ViewersFilms that were paywalled, subscription-only or never available in their language — now legal and free.

04 Case studies · finding demand

We find the demand.
For a film or a genre.

The same model works at the level of a single film and of an entire content category — we find where demand exists and bring the content there.

Case A · Single titleBone ColdIMDb ↗Produced in USA · 2023
Setup
The rights holder released the film on YouTube in one market only — with us.
Result
662Khours1.6M views
Outcome
Results like this lead rights holders to open the title to new markets and territories — and to open more of their catalogue to YouTube.
Case B · Content categoryIndian filmsTarget audience: Central Asia · Women
Insight
Indian cinema was historically very popular in Central Asia, yet under-served on YouTube. We launched a pilot.
Result
1.6Mhours5.2M views · ~20 titles · last 28 days
Outcome
The pilot confirmed the demand. Indian rights holders have approached us, and we are scaling the category.

06 Infrastructure

One system.
Every process.

Backyard RCMS is our proprietary rights and content management system, integrated with YouTube via API. It runs the whole operation — from the signed deal to the royalty payout.

01DealsDeal documents and terms
02Titles & rightsRights are tracked per title, territory, term, exclusivity and language
03LocalizationTranslation and dubbing workflow
04ProgrammingDelivery and scheduling across channels
05AnalyticsPer channel, title, market and partner
06RoyaltiesCalculated automatically, paid next month
Backyard RCMS · distribution scheduler
Backyard RCMS · partner reports
What’s nextBuilt in-house and already running our entire operation. Next, it becomes our partners’ real-time dashboard — and the data foundation for our own AI model.
07 Next chapter

Where we
are going.

Our data shows where specific content has hidden potential in specific territories. The next stage is about turning that into a repeatable engine — and scaling our operations.

01Content Intelligence & AcquisitionsWe use watch time and audience data to identify overlooked films and genres with strong potential in specific territories. These insights guide our licensing decisions, including ongoing discussions with studios in Europe and South America. We are also building our own AI model, trained on this data, to match the right content with the right audience.Smarter acquisitions
02New Languages & MarketsWe are expanding localization into Spanish, Portuguese and German. Localized releases also provide a low-risk entry point for rights holders traditionally hesitant to distribute on YouTube, such as Asian studios — opening the door to more titles, audiences and territories.New content. New audiences
03Partner Transparency & InfrastructureWe are preparing to give rights holders direct access to content performance and market analytics through our proprietary RCMS. Our infrastructure also supports in-house rights management, automated royalty calculations and partner payments in the month following the reporting period.Transparency at scale
Self-funded$700K+ invested in content to date. Every dollar of profit is reinvested into operations and the content portfolio.

Why we manage rights ourselves
01
Exclusive licensee
Most of our 2,000+ assets are licensed to us exclusively for defined language markets. Protecting them is not only our right, but our contractual responsibility to the rights holder.
02
Direct accountability
We report directly to our 30+ partners. In-house rights protection, transparent analytics and next-month royalties earn their trust.
03
Trust brings new content
Many partners put their films on YouTube for the first time. Direct, transparent work is the only way to bring them to the platform.
